basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old graphic designer living in Chicago. I moved here for work after graduating from college last year. In my free time, I enjoy exploring the local music scene, particularly indie and alternative bands. I'm pretty introverted but love the occasional night out with friends. I'm single and currently navigating the dating scene, which is a mix of hilarious and frustrating stories. I'm usually online late at night, often scrolling through Reddit to unwind after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, which is where I picked up most of my skills. I'm constantly learning new techniques through online courses and YouTube tutorials. I wouldn't call myself an expert, but I'm pretty good at what I do. Recently, I've been into learning more about mental health, partly because of personal experiences and partly because it's something I think more people should understand.
